label: accepted

evidence.V1: Front and silhouette give a clean round-top kite/teardrop outline, mirror-even (A15 X err 0.6%); three-quarter still reads as a shield; top is edge-on slab plus handle, acceptable for a flat shield.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: gold rim + teal field (big), raised cream star (medium), six steel rivets (small) evenly spaced along the rim.
evidence.V3: Chunky rim, oversized centred star and stubby rivets give a confident stylised kite; field inset and plate thickness proportionate.
evidence.V4: Star arms, field lip and rim face carry consistent small chamfers that catch the light in the studio close-ups.
evidence.V5: No pinches, seams or z-fighting, but the rim's outer wall shows coarse segment facets (broad flat bands in the rim studio close-up and the top view) and the field outline is slightly stepped in flat light.
evidence.V6: Gold rim, one teal hue in two values, warm cream emblem, steel rivets; colourways only swap the field hue.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold/cream/steel palette, bevels and rivet style consistent with the kit shields.
evidence.V9: Studio line: origin at handle, CollisionFidelity Box, CanCollide off, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: Coarse faceting on the rim outer wall (visible bands in rim close-up and top view)
Slightly stepped field/rim outline under flat light
top_fixes: Add segments (or smooth/weighted normals) to the rim outer wall so the curved band shades smoothly
Smooth the field and rim outline curve so the teardrop contour has no visible steps
Optionally lengthen and straighten the lower taper so it reads more distinctly as a kite than a teardrop
